units.source_text: 叶子连连点头：“快点呀，快点呀！”

en.t: Yoko nodded again and again: "Hurry, hurry!"

units.source_text: 她说着转身就跑，快得简直令人难以置信。

en.t: As she said it, she turned and ran off, so quickly it was almost unbelievable.

units.source_text: 目送着叶子渐渐远去的背影，岛村的心头掠过了这种场合不应有的疑团：那位姑娘的表情为什么总是那么认真呢？

en.t: Watching Yoko's figure gradually recede into the distance, Shimamura felt a doubt flicker through his mind that had no place in such a moment: why was that girl's expression always so earnest?
